skill.summary: AI planning coach using the 4To1 Method™ — turn 4-year vision into daily action. Connects to Notion, Todoist, Google Calendar, or local Markdown. Use when user wants to plan goals, do weekly reviews, track projects, or set up a planning system.

latestVersion.changelog: Major update: Pivoted to AI Planning Coach. Now live on Telegram (@fourtooneplannerbot). Correct 4to1 Method hierarchy: 4 Years → 3 Months → 2 Weeks → 1 Day. All templates free. Supports Notion, Todoist, Google Calendar, local Markdown.
